Container.Name: zettnas-toolkit
Container.Overview: ZettNAS hardware controller, LCD dashboard (direct framebuffer renderer), ARGB lightbar effects & active thermal fan curve daemon.
Container.ExtraParams: --restart=unless-stopped --cap-add=SYS_RAWIO --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN --device-cgroup-rule="c 29:* rwm" --device-cgroup-rule="c 226:* rwm" --device-cgroup-rule="c 188:* rwm" --device-cgroup-rule="c 166:* rwm" --device-cgroup-rule="b 8:* rwm" --device-cgroup-rule="b 259:* rwm"

Config.Name: Persistent State & Data
Config.Description: Persistent state, sqlite database, configurations, and wallpapers

Config.Name: Storage Pool
Config.Description: Target user array pool for disk usage calculation and file ingest

Config.Name: Unraid emhttp Telemetry
Config.Description: Unraid real-time array, parity check and mover state

Config.Name: Host Timezone
Config.Description: Host local time for synchronous clock and LCD display

Config.Name: Unraid Network Config
Config.Description: Unraid network configuration for interface and gateway resolution

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket for container telemetry and management

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Administrator password for WebUI access (change immediately on first run)
